def transform(grid):
    """Recolor uniform full-width/full-height divider lines to 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(w):
            result[r][c] = 2
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h):
            result[r][c] = 2
    return result
PY
